በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ሊቃነ: ሊቅ — chief, elder (noun; plural construct 'chiefs of')
መንክር: መንክር — wonder, marvel; wondrous (noun/adj.; here 'of wonder')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
ወካዕበ: ካዕበ — and again (ወ- + adverb) · 'and also, moreover' where it adds a further item (ወካዕበ ተቀብረ በህየ 'and he too was buried there', ch. 112)
ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct) · ለ- marking the object, doubling -ኦ on the verb (ቀተሎ ... ለንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'he killed him, the king of the Philistines')
ወለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and to the king of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct)
ኮኖ: ኮነ — it was to him, it became for him (3ms perfect, G, + -ኦ '3ms to him')
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ሞአ: ሞአ — he overcame, prevailed (3ms perfect, G, m-w-ʾ; in ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር the case of ቃለ leaves the subject uncertain) (?)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
ወሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — and a cart, chariot (ወ- + noun)
ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
ወዘይከውን: ኮነ — and which will be (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-w-n)
ወኤልያስ: ኤልያስ — Elijah, Elias (proper name; here a personal name, son of Arni; ወ- 'and')
አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
እከሥት: ከሠተ — I will reveal, explain (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G)
ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
ተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he transgressed, overstepped (3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä) · it surpassed (ወእምሰሎሞንኒ ተዐደወ ጥበብኪ 'your wisdom surpassed even Solomon')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ) · 'from' (?) before ቀላየ ባሕር, standing for a preposition because the relative 'which' fits poorly (እንተ ቀላየ ባሕር 'from the depths of the sea', Psalm 68:22) (?)
ሠራዕነ: ሠርዐ — we ordained, established (1cp perfect, G)
ሃይማኖተ: ሃይማኖት — faith (noun, fem.; accusative) · construct 'faith of' (ሃይማኖተ ሮም 'the faith of Rome'; ሃይማኖተ ክርስቶስ 'the faith of Christ')
ሀሎ: ሀሎ — be, exist (3ms perfect, present sense 'is') · existed (3ms perfect, past sense: 'before the sun his name existed')
ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
ወያፈልስዎ: አፈለሰ — and they drive him out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative a-stem + -ዎ '3ms him'; impersonal)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
በፈቃዶሙ: ፈቃድ — by their will (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ወገሞራ: ገሞራ — and Gomorrah (ወ- + proper name, place)
ወእግዚእነሂ: እግዚእ — and our lord also (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1pl our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ለአርዳኢሁ: ረድእ — to his disciples (ለ- + plural አርዳኢ of ረድእ + -ሁ '3ms his')
እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
ኀቤክሙ: ኀበ — to you (preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
በአልባሰ: ልብስ — in garments of (በ- + plural አልባስ, construct 'garments of')
ወእንተ: እንተ — and she who, which (ወ- + fem. relative)
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
ወመንበረ: መንበር — and the throne of (ወ- + noun, construct)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘይነብር: ነበረ — dwell, sit, remain (3ms imperfect; ዘ- 'who')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king') · 'of the king', owner after an anticipating suffix (ኅይስናሁ ለንጉሥ 'the worth of the king')
ፋርስ: ፋርስ — Persia (proper name, land; dependent on the construct ንጉሠ 'king of Persia'; also subject, fem.)
ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
ወበፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — and by the will of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct 'will of')
ይትሀወክ: ተሀወከ — it is shaken (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀወከ)
ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
ታበርህ: አብርሀ — she shines (3fs imperfect, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'; subject Zion) · also of wisdom and of a lamp (ጥበብ ወአእምሮ ታበርህ 'wisdom and knowledge shine'; ማኅቶተ እንተ ታበርህ ሊተ 'a lamp that shines for me')
ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ዳግመ: ዳግም — again, a second time (adverb, accusative form in -a)
ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
ዘንተኬ: ዝንቱ — this indeed (accusative ዘንተ + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
እነግረክሙ: ነገረ — I will tell you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ወአለበወኒ: አለበወ — and he gave me understanding (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ለበወ 'understand' + -ኒ '1cs me')
ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
በርትዕት: ርቱዕ — in the right, orthodox (በ- + adjective, fem. ርትዕት)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct) · 'than the voice of, more than' in comparison (ወአፍቀሩ ቃለ መሰንቆ እምቃለ መዝሙር 'they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm')
ትሄሉ: ሀሎ — she exists, is (3fs imperfect, h-l-w)
ወአውሥእዎ: አውሥአ — and they answered him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ś-ʾ; + -ዎ 'him')
ለገባሬ: ገባሪ — the doer of (ለ- marking the object + participle, construct)
ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
እደዊሃ: እድ — her hands (plural እደው, construct-form እደዊ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
እምቅድሜነ: ቅድሜ — from before us (እም- + ቅድሜ- 'before' + -ነ '1cp us')
ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
